name: Unidentified T-series tactical droid (Naboo)
description: A T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid with feminine programming served Count Dooku on Naboo. She escorted in a disguised Jar Jar Binks to see General Grievous. Later, she is going for the prisoner exchange that the B1-series battle droids carry the Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker to free General Grievous. As Grievous is freed, she threw his lightsaber to Anakin and return to the shuttle.
